title: Birthdays Consolidation
goal: Review party vocabulary, tener for age and dates, and earlier A1 language.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: Review party vocabulary and the verbs decorate, sing, and write.
Review stating age with tener and dates with the months.
Review ser, tener, and hay together in context.
Review family vocabulary while describing a birthday celebration.
Review connecting ideas with pero, con and sin, and saying what you know with saber.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can review party vocabulary and the verbs decorate, sing, and write.
I can review stating age with tener and dates with the months.
I can review ser, tener, and hay together in context.
I can review family vocabulary while describing a birthday celebration.
I can review connecting ideas with pero, con and sin, and saying what I know with saber.
